name: Pumble
one_liner: Team chat app by CAKE.com with an API addon (API key, Swagger-documented HTTP API) and an official MCP server driven by Pumble apps.
auth_notes: API addon: install in workspace, generate API key in sidebar. Pumble apps (Configure apps > Create app) yield App key, user token and bot token with scopes; these drive the MCP server.
access_notes: Pricing page states the FREE plan has no limitations; no plan gate for API addon or app creation is stated. Needs a user able to install the addon in the workspace. 7-day trial of paid features also offered.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve on free plan; API addon exposes about 7 documented actions; MCP server lists 19 tools gated by app scopes. Narrow API and per-workspace install.

needs_human_reason: Swagger URL and webhook/event support for Pumble apps not verified.

access.quote: Our FREE plan doesn't have any limitations and is perfectly suited for startups and non-profit organizations

api_surface.quote: The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.

mcp.quote: you will have to create a Pumble addon and take credentials from there

disputes.why: Pricing page says FREE plan has no limitations; no paid plan stated for API addon or key generation.
No gate found; only narrow API, which is a caveat not a blocker.
Help page lists 7 actions; MCP lists 19 tools.
Pumble app user/bot tokens are bearer-style tokens.
